text:
ana: heads up — found a weird interaction in the dashboard table when users resize columns. If you make the table narrower, the toast for "Runtime settings saved" covers the row action buttons and the ghost button focus ring gets clipped.

mike: can you paste a quick repro? is this in chrome only?

ana: repro steps: open Models > Versions, shrink the panel width until horizontal scroll appears, resize the "Last updated" column to ~40px, then click Save in the per-row menu. toast appears bottom-right and overlaps the popover actions.

sophia: hmm. sounds like two separate layering issues — toast z-index vs popover, and overflow clipping on the table container.

trevor: accessibility-wise it's bad: keyboard users tab to the ghost button, the focus ring gets clipped by overflow:auto container. also toast steals focus briefly (we should avoid that).

mike: quick guess: .table-scroller has overflow:auto + position:relative which creates a new stacking context, so the toast (position:fixed) might be visually behind if we set z-index weird. but clipping of focus ring means the scroller is hiding the box-shadow. could fix with outline-offset or increase scroll container padding.

katy: what about moving toasts to top-right for this view? less likely to overlap important controls.

ana: top-right could help but dashboard has other widgets there. prefer fixing z-index and avoiding clipping. also we shouldn't change global toast position for one screen.

mike: here's a quick CSS patch I tried locally:```css
/* keep focus rings visible */
.table-scroller { overflow: visible; }
.table-row { outline-offset: 4px; }
```
Not perfect — making scroller visible breaks intended scroll behavior.

sophia: maybe limit the overflow change to the action-cell only: .row-actions { overflow: visible; position: relative; z-index: 3; } and ensure toast z-index > 3.

trevor: +1 for not changing global scroll. For focus ring clipping, we can also add:-webkit-focus-ring-color fallback or use a pseudo-element for the ring that isn't clipped. but simpler: add a small right padding so focus ring doesn't hit the scroller edge.

mike: will prototype two fixes: 1) ensure toast z-index is high enough and is position:fixed; 2) add action-cell overflow visible + minimal padding to avoid clipping. will open a PR with screenshots.

ana: thanks. also can we add a test case in storybook: narrow table with toasts so PMs can confirm.

sophia: yup I'll add a Story with keyboard nav scenario. can also include a screenreader note for the toast behavior (should announce but not steal focus).

deploy-bot: build/2079 succeeded on branch fix/table-toast-overlap (CI: all tests passed) :white_check_mark:

mike: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/web-ui/pull/462 — includes CSS tweak + story. screenshots attached.

katy: quick UX nit: the ghost button focus looks a bit faint when there's a dark background. Trevor can you advise contrast?

trevor: if ghost has only 1px stroke and low contrast, not great. recommend 2px focus ring or stronger outline color (contrast ratio >= 3:1 against background). I'll post a token suggestion in design tokens thread.

ana: great — let's keep it in this PR if small. otherwise we'll split. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
